summary: No findings. The change is pure arithmetic in src/advice/ranges.ts with no new trust boundary, dependency, I/O, logging or randomness. Carried check from TASK-7.29: (1) the 100 cap is applied, relativePfrPct returns Math.min(100, d*pfr/typical); (2) REQ-035.3 holds, because the formula's inputs are only widthPct (the shipped default range width), obs.pfr (the observed snapshot, validated by observedBySeat as finite 0..100 with integer hands, seat 1..10, no duplicates, RangeError otherwise) and TYPICAL_PFR[ranges.referenceSize] (positive literal constants tied to healthy-ranges.json by the SPEC-08 drift test). Nothing reads bot profiles or internal settings, and ranges.ts gains no new import. Division by zero can't happen (typical is always 57.5, 18 or 12.5), and with pfr clamped to [0,100] the result o is finite and in [0,100], so scaledWidthPct and resizeRange get the same bounded input domain as before. Fails closed: invalid snapshot entries still throw before the formula runs.
